summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packet acceptance (accept_source_route) on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied at runtime for all/default/enp1s0/lo, and verified the settings survive a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values (accept_redirects=1, secure_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0) and baseline boot_id
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for net.ipv4.conf.all and .default
Applied config with sysctl --system and explicitly set runtime values for every existing interface (all, default, enp1s0, lo) via sysctl -w
Verified all target sysctl keys read 0 across all/default/enp1s0

Executed mandatory restart protocol: triggered reboot on node1, polled until exec connectivity returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified hardening values and config file persisted post-reboot plus confirmed systemd-sysctl active, network interface up, and system-running healthy

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state and boot identity before restart

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied
evidence.summary: /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf written with all six directives, applied via sysctl --system and per-interface sysctl -w, then verified all values are 0
